note: Times are reel-relative seconds, half-open. Order = narrative order for the selects reel, not reel order.

selects.label: gail-buildup-amazed
selects.quote: They are gonna be amazed... you might have some criers on our hands... part of our story going forward

selects.label: gail-buildup-family
selects.quote: A lasting reminder because we are a family... knit together by so much more than music... a permanent tribute

selects.label: gail-buildup-noidea
selects.quote: They're down there right now and they have no idea... I can't wait to see the reaction

selects.label: gail-thesis
selects.quote: Sometimes just a song or an act of kindness can change someone's life

selects.label: trish-reveal
selects.quote: There, my darling... It's us... You actually made this? I did. I've been practicing... the big reveal... You lead the way

selects.label: trish-cominghome
selects.quote: It's kind of coming home. We've been here many times since, but this is like a celebration

selects.label: group-intro
selects.quote: Something very special for you all... floral jewelry, because it's not a corsage - this is something you will always have

selects.label: group-pinning
selects.quote: It's been a while since a man had his hand in my shirt... Did you ever imagine? Never in my wildest dreams

selects.label: group-love
selects.quote: Think of the love you are sharing... music is love... My heart's just full - mine is too... I really mean thank you

selects.label: group-sendoff
selects.quote: Go get ready, break a leg, have some fun

selects.label: neville-foodforsoul
selects.quote: At your rehearsal the love you shared... you are truly family... Music is food for the soul

selects.label: group-hug
selects.quote: Give me a big group hug and off we go... Share love through the beauty of music

selects.label: neville-button-dolls
selects.quote: What a bunch of dolls. Absolutely brilliant... just glorious

selects.label: neville-button-likethem
selects.quote: Well, I think they like them. I mean, there's that. Thank goodness

selects.label: concert-intro
selects.quote: These ladies are no strangers to us at the Berkeley... without further ado, the ukulele ladies, 60 and Change

selects.label: concert-trish-welcome
selects.quote: Thank you very much, Kathy... thank you all for coming out again

selects.label: concert-origin
selects.quote: Our little group came together in January 2023... I planned the lesson for 90 minutes... that quickly went to two hours... they said how about weekly

selects.label: concert-song-light
selects.quote: This Little Light of Mine (traditional - rights-safe) on the ukulele Trish was gifted two days ago

selects.label: concert-momstory
selects.quote: I had a dream to play ukulele for seniors... it wasn't my dream anymore, it was OUR dream... mom's toe would be tapping... I wanted to give back

selects.label: concert-twochords
selects.quote: Our first was like two chords... now hundreds of songs in our library

selects.label: concert-close
selects.quote: Thanks again Kathy... we asked the newbies if they would come back, and they said Yeah

selects.label: concert-thankyou
selects.quote: Thank you everybody

selects.label: neville-goodbye
selects.quote: Was it a good job? It was so much more than that... the man spelling out the words, not always to the right song... continue to share all your love through music

selects.label: trish-touched
selects.quote: The beautiful pins from Neville, the gift yesterday, the flowers... I'm at a loss for words... my daughter said you probably cried, right Mom?... a full circle thing... it's amazing

selects.label: trish-feedsus
selects.quote: Performance number 22... it feeds us to do this work for the seniors

selects.label: trish-mom
selects.quote: Mom's toe would be tapping... I hadn't heard my name in ten years, but she could still relate to the music

selects.label: trish-gail
selects.quote: I am so lucky to have Gail in my life. So blessed

selects.label: trish-parallel
selects.quote: Neville with his flowers, us with a song somebody can sing back... it really touches my soul... the arrangement I received yesterday is stunning

selects.label: trish-thesis
selects.quote: Everyone can do acts of kindness... what you think is something small is huge to somebody else... we need more of that in the world

selects.label: gail-soulsister
selects.quote: What can I say about Trish? She's a soul sister... she works countless hours... I love her to death, friends forever and beyond

selects.label: gail-1111
selects.quote: You are mom, Trish... they're smiling down today... I looked at my dashboard - 11:11, angel hours

selects.label: gail-unsung
selects.quote: Their acts of kindness don't go unnoticed... the slightest smile or hug can change a life... I believe in rising above

selects.label: gail-celebration
selects.quote: A really special part is afterwards, meeting the people... in long-term care people feel forgotten, and we need to value our seniors

selects.label: gail-mushy
selects.quote: Trish, and I told her: there's nothing wrong with being mushy
